{{Top|leg}}
"'''Blood Ridge'''" was the name given by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vur IV]] to a fortified position on the world during their fight against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. A small group of Mandalorians led by [[Worr Muugyn]] held the ridge and fought off the Jedi for several days in the [[Battle of Blood Ridge]].
